faqs.q: How much does a project cost?
faqs.a: Every engagement starts with a consultation, so you get a written estimate before committing. Typical ranges depend on scope — we’ll give you a clear number and what’s included (and excluded) in writing.

faqs.q: Do you work with clients outside Tanzania?
faqs.a: Yes. We’re based in Dar es Salaam (UTC+3) and work with clients worldwide — calls are scheduled in your timezone, and projects run with shared docs and regular check-ins.

faqs.q: Who owns the code and designs?
faqs.a: You do. On handover you receive the source code, design files and documentation, with no lock-in to us.

faqs.q: Can you take over an existing project?
faqs.a: Often, yes. Send us the current state (repo, designs or a short screen recording) and we’ll tell you honestly whether we’re the right team to continue it.

privacy.lead: Last updated: November 2026. This is a placeholder policy — have your lawyer review it before launch.

sections.a: When you contact us (form or email), we receive whatever you choose to share — typically your name, email address and a description of your idea. We don’t collect sensitive personal data through this website.
Only to reply to your enquiry, prepare for a call, and — if you become a client — to deliver the project. We never sell your data or share it with advertisers.
This site doesn’t set advertising cookies. If you add analytics later (e.g. a privacy-friendly tool), update this section and add a consent notice.
Enquiry emails are kept for up to 24 months, then deleted. Client project records are kept as long as legally required for accounting.
You can ask what we hold about you, request correction or deletion at any time — email hello@nexabie.co.tz.
